Advanced product from the Geffen Magic Academy!

Up to 10 valid searches can be conducted per use.
patch_notes: Bargain Hunter's Catalogue no longer crashes with "hide searches" on. Typing filters the list already loaded, "Items: N" follows the filter, Next respects the filtered pages, and the "Searches left" text no longer shows in that mode.

Bargain Hunter's Catalogue now list every vending shop in Alberta at once and filter as you type. The list refreshes every 2 seconds and everyone reads from the same snapshot, so it stays light on the server.
